# Harald Merckelbach

> Academic resource on forensic psychology, validity testing, and psychological assessment by a leading Dutch psychology professor.

Harald Merckelbach is a psychology professor at Universiteit Maastricht specializing in forensic psychology, memory research, and symptom validity testing. This site serves as a comprehensive archive of his research, publications, and professional work in clinical and forensic psychology.

## Key Topics

- Forensic psychology
- Symptom validity testing
- Memory research
- SRSI (Symptom Validity Test)
- Clinical diagnosis
- Psychological assessment
- Maladaptive daydreaming
- Expert witness testimony
- Psychology and law
- Dutch psychology
- Universiteit Maastricht
- Validity testing
- Psychotherapy
- Clinical psychology

## About Harald Merckelbach

- [Academic Profile & Biography](https://haraldmerckelbach.nl/etc.html): Academic profile and biography of Harald Merckelbach, psychology professor at Universiteit Maastricht

## Books & Publications

- [Books Overview](https://haraldmerckelbach.nl/boeken_overzicht.html): Overview of books by Harald Merckelbach on forensic psychology and validity testing
- [Research Publications](https://haraldmerckelbach.nl/publications.html): Research publications and psychological assessment scales including SRSI and Maladaptive Daydreaming Scale

## Articles & Research

- [Articles Archive](https://haraldmerckelbach.nl/artikelen_overzicht.html): Archive of psychology articles by Harald Merckelbach on forensic and clinical topics

## Opinion & Commentary

- [Columns](https://haraldmerckelbach.nl/columns.html): Opinion columns and personal essays by Harald Merckelbach on psychology and social topics
